name: DirectXSplat Renderer API
definition: A D3D12-based renderer API for Gaussian splats that manages scene loading, chunk mutations, LOD/culling configuration, and rendering via a prepare-then-render pipeline.
summary: DirectXSplat is a high-performance C++ library for rendering 3D Gaussian Splats via Direct3D 12, distinguished by its host-owned device architecture and optimized rasterization pipeline.
